name: Notifications
description: Tell people about something through the kernel: stored in the organization, pushed to whoever is connected.

capabilities.name: Send Notification
capabilities.description: Send a notification to the organization's members, to specific users or visitors, or back to the caller. Maps to kernel command notify::send.

capabilities.name: Notify Everyone
capabilities.description: Also send to everyone connected, anonymous visitors included. Needed, besides notify::send, for the `everyone` audience.
